About.label: About
About.title: About Me
About.description1: I'm Amirmohammad, a 19-year-old software developer. I've been passionate about programming since childhood, and for the past three years I've been professionally learning and building real-world projects. Currently, I work as a Full-Stack Web Developer.
About.description2: Alongside freelancing, I'm passionate about sharing my knowledge. I professionally teach programming through comprehensive courses as well as short and free educational content.

Experience.label: Experience
Experience.title: Experience & Career Journey
Experience.exp1Description: After several years of learning and building projects, I started working professionally on real-world full-stack projects, covering everything from frontend development to backend, databases, and APIs.
Experience.exp2Description: I started web development with JavaScript, React, Node.js, and MongoDB, building various projects and gaining hands-on experience with APIs, authentication, databases, and full-stack application architecture.
Experience.exp3Description: I started programming with Pawn by developing scripts for SA-MP servers. I later moved into web development, learning HTML, CSS, and JavaScript and continuing my journey into software development.

Projects.label: Projects
Projects.title: Featured Work
Projects.project1Description: A high-performance modern e-commerce storefront for Apple devices featuring instant cart updates, dynamic product filtering, and a responsive mobile-first UI.
Projects.project2Description: A scalable monorepo backend architecture modeled after Snapp, featuring real-time driver-passenger dispatch via WebSockets, asynchronous message queues with RabbitMQ, and Redis caching.
Projects.project3Description: An end-to-end full-stack digital marketplace for trading gaming accounts, complete with secure authentication, automated order workflows, and real-time inventory management.
